newsitem.title: USA: Midcoast Energy buys Vealmoor stake.
newsitem.headline: Midcoast Energy buys Vealmoor stake.

text.p: Midcoast Energy Resources Inc said on Tuesday that it has jointly acquired a royalty interest in the East Vealmore Unit producing property in Borden and Howard Coutnies in Texas from Bankers Multiple Line Insurance Co.
Midcoast said it made the acquisition as part of a group led by Brazos Resources Inc.
The purchase price was $1.35 million, of which Midcoast's share was $950,000, it said.
Production from the unit averages 810 barrels of oil per day and 400,000 cubic feet of gas per day, it said.
